reference.impl: llama.cpp b1-de32b26, observational dumper against libllama

comparison.note: Top-6 sets identical. Order differs only for ids 13 and 450, which are tied at 66.52 in the reference. Difference is fp16 accumulation vs llama.cpp's kernels.

root_cause_of_the_apparent_failure: Misdiagnosis, not a code defect. The Phase 3 implementation was already correct. llama.cpp's own logits are flat (top-5 spread 1.76), so flatness was never a bug symptom. The '4' seen from llama-cli is displayed text downstream of a leading space token (29871); the model's actual top token in both implementations is 29871.
correction_made: Phase 3A removed MoE renormalisation on the strength of the HF sparsemixer source. That was wrong and was reverted. llama.cpp's build_moe_ffn evidently renormalises for this architecture, and the reference logits only match with renormalisation.
limitations: Per-layer intermediate hooks (llama_set_embeddings_layer_inp) abort inside build_graph for PHIMOE, so layer-by-layer comparison was not possible; parity is established at the logits layer.
final_hidden differs (cosine 0.854) because llama.cpp reports it post-final-norm while the runtime returns the pre-norm layer output; only logits are directly comparable.
